name: Pushover
label: Pushover — Pushover Message API v1
description: Pushover via the official Pushover Message API v1. Base https://api.pushover.net/1. Docs: https://pushover.net/api. Emergency priority has extra cost / quota. Do not implement Glances or Open Client. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Pushover operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"push"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: push | list-sounds. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Notification body (required for push). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Optional title. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: priority
schema.description: -2 .. 2. Emergency (2) requires retry ≥30 and expire ≤10800. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: retry
schema.description: Emergency retry seconds (min 30). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: expire
schema.description: Emergency expire seconds (max 10800). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: sound
schema.description: Sound name from list-sounds. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: push, list-sounds. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Application token
configurationParameters.description: Pushover application API token. Query/body token. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: user
configurationParameters.description: Recipient user or group key (30 chars). Form/query user. StudioQuack secret.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
